_spec: hopeOS body-puppet MOVEMENT contract v1 — 2D PROCEDURAL variant (sibling of fox.body.contract.json). Same human half (BodyProbe measures + PuppetInput face/mouth channels + BodyGestureDetector events); the puppet half targets a procedural 2D mock-3D rig (sdk/interaction/lizard2d.js) instead of GLB bones. Positions still never cross the human->puppet boundary: channels carry torso-normalized MEASURES; the 2D rig turns them into gait phase, aim angles, tongue length and leap impulses in its own world space.

human.face_stack: PuppetInput(vid) — WITH video pixels: tongue red-ratio drives tongue.out 1:1; mouth MAR drives jaw; head matrix drives aim
human.smoothing: One-Euro on the HUMAN side only (BodyProbe / PuppetInput); rig applies raw
human.gesture_source: BodyGestureDetector: jump | squat | duck. PLUS two game-side derived events (see derived_events)
calibration_ritual: arms at sides        -> limb raise baseline (defaults fine)
stick tongue out 1s  -> tongue.max personal red-ratio ceiling

puppet.renderer: canvas2d, back-POV pseudo-3D: world (x lateral, y up, z depth into screen), perspective scale = f/(f+z), painter z-sort
puppet.asset: none — rig is generated (sdk/interaction/lizard2d.js), shaded with gradients to read as 3D

rig.spine: 9-point chain tail(near camera)->head(far), lateral sine undulation counter-phased to gait
rig.limbs: 4x sprawled 2-segment (lizard posture: upper limb OUT sideways, lower limb DOWN to foot), anatomical correspondence arms->front, legs->hind
rig.head: yaw/pitch aim turret for hunting; jaw hinge from mouth.open; eyes blink from eye channels
rig.tongue: verlet-ish chain from jaw, length-driven; SHOOT is a ballistic extend with sticky tip + elastic retract
rig.tail: 6-point chain, sway = -undulation phase, whips on leap

puppet.forward: -z toward horizon (lizard faces AWAY, same heading as player — mirrored-selfie left/right feel identical)

stance_translation.rule: STANDING human = lizard neutral sprawl on the branch. Arms -> front legs, legs -> hind legs (crawl-scheme direct mapping, Become the Beast arXiv:2603.15428). Alternating arm raises = gait steps = forward scroll.
stance_translation.sides: anatomical: player LEFT arm -> lizard LEFT front leg; lizard rendered from behind so left/right feel identical

channels.meaning: lift lizard front-left foot; raise->lower cycle = one step
human squat -> lizard hugs the branch, pre-leap coil (charges leap distance +25%)
lean left/right slides the lizard across the branch width — dodge and line up jumps

map.meaning_note: slightly OVER 1:1 — hunting is the game; aim must feel powerful

channels.meaning: lizard head aims where you look; tongue fires along this ray
jaw opens with your mouth; tongue cannot fire through a closed jaw (open >= arm_threshold arms the shot)
SAME-LENGTH RULE: your tongue reach = lizard tongue reach, live, 1:1
lizard blinks when you blink (nictitating shimmer)

tongue.shoot.detect: d(tongue.out)/dt > shoot_vel while mouth.open > 0.08 — the sudden FAST extension, distinct from slow show-length. FALLBACK: the discrete MouthTriggers tongueOut event also fires the shot when velocity > 0.7/s (robust when red-ratio undershoots in dim light)
tongue.shoot.impl: ballistic tongue: tip flies along aim ray at tongue_speed, sticks to fly inside hit cone, elastic retract 140ms carrying prey

leap.hop.detect: RABBIT MOVE: both arms thrust forward together — limb.armL.extend AND limb.armR.extend rising > hop_extend_vel within 400ms of each other, both raises in band [-0.4, 0.6] (forward-ish thrust). BodyGestureDetector 'jump' also accepted. THE FIRST hop engages AUTO-RUN.
leap.hop.impl: lizard leap: crouch-coil 90ms -> parabolic launch (base 2.4 branch-gaps forward, +25% if body.crouch was >0.5) -> tail whip -> land compress. Realistic lizard timing: fast launch, floaty apex, sticky landing.

gait.rule: AUTO-RUN (primary): the FIRST leap.hop engages a forward base speed — the lizard runs like an obstacle-runner; body.lean steers, head hunts, crouch charges leaps. Limb raise->lower cycles past step_threshold ADD speed on top (cadence bonus) and still drive per-leg lifts — sync enriches, but never blocks, locomotion.
gait.forward_speed: cadence * 0.34 body-lengths per step, clamp 1.5 body-lengths/s (x2 during leap flight)
gait.idle_behavior: sway breathing, tail curl, head micro-saccades toward nearest fly (the lizard WANTS the fly; keeps idle alive)

hunt.rule: Head aim ray (yaw/pitch) + tongue shoot speed decide the catch. Correct angle + timing = guaranteed hit (aim-assist cone). Distance check: fly must be within reach = tongue max length at shoot moment.
hunt.fly_speed_ramp: gentle asymptotic, soft-cap x2.1 (flies stay inside tongue range; the challenge is aim+timing, not chase)
hunt.reachability: high flies need LEAP + mid-air shoot: cone widens x1.5 during flight (the payoff move)

constraints.same_length_honesty: tongue.out maps 1:1 (gamma 1.1 only denoises the floor) — the player's own tongue IS the controller; never fake extra reach outside the aim-assist cone
constraints.hold_on_loss: pose/face lost -> freeze channels, decay to idle after idle_after_ms; never snap
constraints.ground_lock: lizard y locked to branch surface except leap/fall channels
constraints.fall: off branch edge with no branch below -> fall (score streak reset, respawn on last branch after climb-up beat); leap distance vs gap width is the honest physics check
